summary: [spec-fidelity] The checker follows contract 1.1.2 (strict patch of the 1.1.1 the brief and scenarios pin; I diffed the vendored schemas, 204 examples, regex-cases.json and guide.schema against both tags: byte-identical), but two 1.1.2 behaviours have no test: (a) a failing `setup` step is FIXTURE_INVALID reason SETUP_FAILED with no check reported (grep SETUP_FAILED in tests: none; I ran canon's fixture with a failing setup step by hand: exit 2, SETUP_FAILED, no data, correct); (b) L1.validators runs in an empty directory without `prepare` (exec.rs Call.without_setup) and no seeded case depends on `prepare`; by hand, a wrapper tool whose rejects answers another code when a prepare-made file is absent fails only L1.validators, as 1.1.2 says. Brief F5 still says validators reuse the environment `prepare` made ('L1은 prepare가 만든 환경에서 validators가 setup 없이 돌 때도 같은 환경을 쓴다'): that sentence is stale against 1.1.2 and the CHANGELOG/workflow comments also say 'contract 1.1.1'. Brief defect for the human; tests for (a) and (b) for the implementer. Blast radius: a canon validator that needs the git repository `prepare` makes would fail here, not in canon's own tests.
